dialogue.origin: こんにちは、相談員です今日はご相談ありがとうございます最初に年齢と性別を教えていただけますか
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming in for a consultation today. To start, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.origin: ４３歳　女性ですよろしくお願い致します
dialogue.content: I'm 43 years old and female. It's nice to meet you.

dialogue.origin: 教えてくださって、ありがとうございますよろしくお願いいたしますご相談はどういった内容でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing that with me. It's nice to meet you as well. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.origin: 人とお話ししたり、何かをする時に、失敗しないか心配して落ち着かないんです。どうしたらもっと気軽に生活できますか？
dialogue.content: When I talk to people or do things, I worry about failing and can't calm down. How can I live more at ease?

dialogue.origin: なるほど、心配してしまわれるんですね具体的に、どういった場面で心配が強くなって落ち着かなくなりますか？
dialogue.content: I see, so you find yourself worrying. Could you tell me more specifically, in what kind of situations does your worry become stronger and you feel unsettled?

dialogue.origin: もし具体的な場面が思いつかなれば、日頃、感じていることでも良いので、教えていただけると嬉しいです
dialogue.content: If no specific situations come to mind, it's also fine to share what you usually feel day to day. I'd appreciate hearing about that.

dialogue.origin: 出かけて人と会う時の朝などに、今日の予定を考えると、今日ちゃんと過ごせるかなって、なんか落ち着かない気持ちになります
dialogue.content: On mornings when I'm going out to meet people, for example, when I think about my plans for the day, I start to wonder if I'll be able to get through the day properly, and I get this restless feeling.

dialogue.origin: そのうち忘れてるんですけど、なんか、なんでも上手にこなさないといけないと自動的に思ってしまうみたいで‥
dialogue.content: I forget about it after a while, but it's like I automatically think that I have to handle everything perfectly...

dialogue.origin: やる前から失敗したらどうしようと不安になります。出来ればそう感じず、気持ちよく取り掛かりたいんですけど
dialogue.content: Even before I start, I get anxious thinking, 'What if I fail?' I wish I didn't feel that way and could just start things with a more positive mindset.

dialogue.origin: 日々のとことでも、ちゃんとこなさないとと思うと、辛いですよね
dialogue.content: It must be difficult to feel like you have to handle even everyday things perfectly.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです。気負いしてしまい、リラックスできません。どうしたらいいでしょう？
dialogue.content: That's right. I put too much pressure on myself and can't relax. What should I do?

dialogue.origin: それはいつか頃から、そういう気持ちになっていましたか？
dialogue.content: Since about when have you been feeling this way?

dialogue.origin: 子どもが学校行き出してからな様に思います。昔から気にしいな面はあったのですが‥
dialogue.content: I think it started after my children started school. I've always had a tendency to worry, though...

dialogue.origin: お子さんがいらっしゃるんですね。お子さんが学校に行かれるようになって、なにか心境の変化はありましたか？
dialogue.content: So you have children. When they started school, did anything shift in how you felt?

dialogue.origin: はい、2人います。子どもをちゃんと育てないといけない、何か私が失敗したら子どもにマイナスになると思う様になって
dialogue.content: Yes, I have two. I started to feel that I have to raise my children properly, and that if I fail at something, it will have a negative impact on them.

dialogue.origin: なるほどそれはプレッシャーを感じますよね自分のことではなく、お子さんのこととなると余計に心配になってしまうんでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see, that sounds like a lot of pressure. Do you find that you worry even more because it's about your children, not just yourself?

dialogue.origin: はい。幼稚園、小学校で、私が嫌われると子どもが外される、、など、心配して、敏感に周りに合わしてるうちに、その緊張が取れなくなってしまったと感じています。
dialogue.content: Yes. I worry that if I'm disliked at the kindergarten or elementary school, my child will be excluded. As I tried to sensitively fit in with everyone, I feel like I've become unable to let go of that tension.

dialogue.origin: 学校などでのお子さんの様子は直接には分からないから、心配になってしまいすよね
dialogue.content: You can't directly see how your children are doing at school, so it's natural to worry, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: お子さんが学校に入られる前は、その心配が強い面はどうだったのですか？
dialogue.content: Before your children started school, what was that tendency to worry like?

dialogue.origin: そうですね。子どもの様子からいじめられてないとかは、感じるんですが、不安が先走って緊張してしまい、会話を楽しむより、こなすっていう感覚になってしまいます。
dialogue.content: That's right. I can tell from how my children act that they aren't being bullied or anything, but my anxiety gets the best of me and I get tense. It feels more like I'm 'getting through' conversations rather than enjoying them.

dialogue.origin: 自分が学生の時は、やはり外されたら怖いと言う気持ちで、周りに合わせがちでした。成人後子ども学校入学前はそんなに気にならず、気楽にしてた様に思います
dialogue.content: When I was a student, I was also afraid of being excluded, so I tended to go along with what everyone else was doing. After becoming an adult but before my children started school, I don't think I worried about it so much and was more easygoing.

dialogue.origin: 女子校で人間関係シビアだつた影響もあるんでしょうか‥？
dialogue.content: I wonder if it's also because I went to an all-girls' school where relationships were tough...?

dialogue.origin: 女性の世界はシビアと言われることもありますもんね・・・
dialogue.content: People do say that women's social worlds can be quite tough...

dialogue.origin: その環境もあるかと思いますが、もともと場の雰囲気を読んで行動できる方だったのかなと思いました。今はお子さんのこともあって、それがより強調されて、失敗しないかと緊張が強くなってしまう状況なのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: That environment may play a role, and I also wonder if you've always been someone who can read the room and act accordingly. With your children in the picture now, might that be amplified, making you more tense about not making mistakes?

dialogue.origin: そうですねーそういうセンサーを貼ってるうちに抜け出せなくなってしまったというか
dialogue.content: Yes—it's like, while keeping those sensors up, I ended up unable to get out of it.

dialogue.origin: 元々鈍感で、周りの人にいろいろ言われたりして、センサーを広げていった感じで、ついに疲れて来たって感じかな
dialogue.content: I was originally not very sensitive, but people around me would say things, so it felt like I gradually expanded my sensors, and now I feel like I've finally gotten tired.

dialogue.origin: なるほど先ほどおっしゃられた通り、人と会う時や話すときなど日常的なことでも、そのセンサーを貼った状態だと、心は疲れてしまいますよね
dialogue.content: I see. As you mentioned earlier, if you're always using that 'sensor' even in everyday situations like meeting or talking to people, it must be mentally exhausting.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね‥何かリラックス出来る良い方法ありますか？
dialogue.content: Right... Is there any good way I can relax?

dialogue.origin: 今まで頑張られてきたんだなと感じました
dialogue.content: I feel that you've been trying so hard all this time.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。もうそろそろ頑張りたくないんです。
dialogue.content: Thank you. I don't want to have to try so hard anymore.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね頑張るって疲れますもんね・・・ちなみに日常的な些細なことで結構ですので、気を貼らずにできたら楽だなと思うことはありますか？
dialogue.content: I understand. It's tiring to always be trying hard... By the way, it can be something small and everyday, but is there anything you wish you could do without being so on guard, something that would make you feel more at ease?

dialogue.origin: 人間関係ですねー話始めたら楽しくなって、気にならない時もあるんですけど、気を使う人とのコミュニケーションは避けがちです。なるべく苦手なシチュエーションに自分を置かない様にしてしまいます
dialogue.content: It's relationships. Once I start talking, sometimes I have fun and don't worry about it, but I tend to avoid communicating with people I have to be careful around. I try to avoid putting myself in situations I'm not comfortable with as much as possible.

dialogue.origin: 人間関係ですね相手がいることって、より気を使いますもんね
dialogue.content: Relationships, I see. When another person is involved, you have to be more considerate, don't you?

dialogue.origin: 苦手なシチュエーションに自分を置かないのは、素敵なアイディアだと思います
dialogue.content: I think avoiding situations you're not comfortable with is a wonderful idea.

dialogue.origin: はい。それほど親しいわけではない人を見かけた時、見つからない様に遠回りするとか、自分で嫌な事してるなと思うんですけど、その後あれこれ気になるのが嫌で接触を避けてしまいます
dialogue.content: Yes. For example, when I see someone I'm not that close with, I'll take a detour to avoid being seen. I feel like I'm doing something unpleasant, but I avoid contact because I don't want to worry about things afterwards.

dialogue.origin: そうですか？素敵というより、ずるい、小賢しいと感じます。
dialogue.content: Really? It feels more sly and cunning than wonderful.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですねずるい、と感じるのはどうしてでしょうか？お答えいただけるようでしたら、教えていただきたいです
dialogue.content: I see. What makes it feel sneaky to you? If you're comfortable sharing, I'd like to hear.

dialogue.origin: うーん、気楽にこんにちはって、お話し出来るようになりたいです。
dialogue.content: Well... I want to be able to just say 'hello' and chat casually.

dialogue.origin: 今日は聞いて頂きありがとうございました。なんとなくスッキリ気が晴れました。
dialogue.content: Thank you for listening to me today. I feel somewhat refreshed and relieved.

dialogue.origin: すいません、うまくお話できず・・・こちらこそ、ありがとうございました！勉強になりました
dialogue.content: I'm sorry I wasn't able to guide our conversation better... Thank you so much as well! This has been a learning experience for me.

dialogue.origin: またよろしくお願いします！
dialogue.content: I look forward to speaking with you again!

topic.sub: 対人関係への不安と緊張感
